title: Two Broad Separated 2D Gaussians (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `vector_two_broad` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Baseline 2D multimodal vector task with two broad isotropic Gaussians at (-1, 0) and (+1, 0) (sigma=0.25), checking basic multimodal coverage, balanced mass, and accurate within-mode spread.
failure_mode: Recipes that collapse mode variance to points fail component_min_eigen_ratio and component_covariance_error.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `vector_two_broad` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
